Morning team —

Quick reminder: our weekly gatekeeper run is today — final submission window opens at 5pm PT. Please do the following before the 4:30pm prep call so we can finalize numbers to Finance: 

- Update stage and ARR in SFDC for all Q2 opportunities (stage, close date, ARR, probability). Use the attached weekly_pipeline_template.xlsx if you need the canonical columns.
- Mark any deals that need an escalation or credit approval with the "revops_flag" tag. Add a one-line reason in the notes field.
- If there are outstanding procurement docs or PO confirmations, upload to the ACME folder and reply-all with the filename.

Prep call (30m) details: 4:30pm PT today — calendar invite link below. Agenda is: 1) quick top-6 deal sweep (10m), 2) risk/commit flags (10m), 3) confirm submission package (10m).

Attachments: weekly_pipeline_template.xlsx
